title: 2016 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: Find the value of the expression \[ \begin{gathered} 100 - 98 + 96 - 94 + 92 - 90 \\ {}+ \cdots + 8 - 6 + 4 - 2. \end{gathered} \]

solutions.text:
We can group the sum as follows: \[ \begin{gathered} (100 - 98) + (96 - 94) \\ {}+ \cdots + (4 - 2). \end{gathered} \] Note that each pair evaluates to \(2\) and there are \(25\) pairs. Therefore, the total sum is \(2 \cdot 25 = 50.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Group the expression into pairs of consecutive terms.
Count how many pairs of the form \(n-(n-2)\) appear.
